_purpose: One authoritative source per product truth; every restatement is a checked mirror. Parent incident classes: stale-copy #13, inherited figures #3, five inconsistent SOC2 tables, SPEC 32-vs-33 fields, SPEC silent on encoding.
_provenance_note: Rows marked [QUOTED: engine.py read] come from the operator-pasted engine source, 2026-08-17. Rows marked [REPORTED: roadmap] come from TITAN_GATE_MASTER_ROADMAP.docx (March 2026, five months stale) and are seeded for the SWEEP to verify -- the registry does not inherit the roadmap's facts, it puts them on trial.
_amendment_rule: Removing or loosening a row requires a reason line in the row's own 'retired' field, kept in place -- silent deletion of an invariant is a stale-copy incident waiting to recur.

rows.violation_response: version mismatch anomaly; all signing claims re-rung

rows.invariant: Merkle algorithm is merkle_v1: leaf = SHA256('L|'+data), node = SHA256('N|'+left+right)
rows.provenance: [REPORTED: roadmap sections 2 and 8 -- on trial, not inherited]

rows.invariant: Composite weights are structural 0.6 / semantic 0.4, and any change bumps SCORING_FORMULA_VERSION in the same commit
